name: Theme toggle
summary: An icon button that cycles light, dark and system mode, showing the icon for the mode in use.
description: System mode follows the operating system as it changes. It changes the theme of this whole docs site too, and the choice is saved in this browser.

classes.name: v-theme-toggle
classes.description: On an icon button holding three icons marked data-for="light|dark|system"; only the current one shows. Hidden until the JS sets data-mode.

states.description: Set by the JS; picks the visible icon.
Kept up to date by the JS, for example "Theme: system (dark). Switch to light".

hooks.name: data-v-theme-toggle
hooks.description: Cycles light, dark, system on click and keeps the icon and the label in sync.

api.description: Sets the mode from code. System removes data-theme so the OS setting applies live.

events.name: v:theme
events.description: Fires after every change, and when the OS switches while in system mode.

a11y: The accessible name says the current mode and the next one, so people know what pressing it will do.
The new mode is announced through the shared live region.
Without JS the button would do nothing, so it stays hidden until data-mode is set.

examples.title: Toggle the mode
examples.description: It changes the theme of this whole docs site too, and the choice is saved in this browser.
examples.html: <button class="v-btn v-btn-icon v-btn-ghost v-theme-toggle" type="button" data-v-theme-toggle aria-label="Theme"><svg class="v-icon" data-for="light" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#sun"/></svg><svg class="v-icon" data-for="dark" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#moon"/></svg><svg class="v-icon" data-for="system" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#monitor"/></svg></button>
